items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: So he took me to Mr. Glaudius Marshall... After meeting Mr. Glaudius Marshall

ctx.x: She said, yes, and so I spoke to my sister and asked her to speak to Mr. Spooner, and going back to Mr. Marshall, Glaudius Marshall, who was the first person I had, wonderful man.
He said, "Well, if there's a chance to -- why, not, Marion Cook is a man that's known, universally known, and known more in the United States as a very, very good musician."
